messages.author: Beatriz Soriano
messages.text: Responder 1 is the major-incident bridge all day Tuesday — protected. Responder 2's Tuesday AM is the identity-platform maintenance block; nobody books on a blocked window.

messages.author: Imre Haviland
messages.text: Register side: grant 3101 (3 objects) is live and revocable; 3088 was signed out by Lotta herself at 06:40. The shared-desk kiosk sessions are a recertification, not this case.

messages.author: Beatriz Soriano
messages.text: Displacing the bridge is Oksana's board, not mine. Nothing approved beyond regular windows.
